question: Tool-planning phase complete. Two registered tools were queried for the current guided parent S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY (region F_b011_s030__reference, window [0.1,0.5], pointwise operator). Findings: (1) conditional_layout on F_b011_s030__NO returned 10 measured fixed-geometry legal layouts with native N at site 22, native_minus_alternate_mean 0.0763, and single exchanges from -0.441 to +0.207; this is a conditional head-score response to legal label swaps, not a coordinate intervention effect, and it does not establish that the native N/O arrangement is realized or retained under the current controller. (2) regional_context on F_b011_s030__NC returned same-root controls (n=40, no same-graph controls) and pocket-field distances: candidate N_acceptor to A:VAL:116:N is 2.961 A versus same-root mean 3.279 A (n=36), and O_acceptor to the same site is 10.091 A versus same-root mean 8.977 A (n=40); field association is not a proven contact or energy. (3) regional_trajectories on F_b011_s030__NO is explicitly historical_steer_not_current_guidance, so its signed_dx/dy/dz and spatial_mass curves describe teacher ancestry, not the current guided parent. (4) control_response on F_b011_s030__NC returned no matching parents; only active-incumbent context was available, which is not a substitute for a program-and-region-matched response. Consequently the formation/retention link for the N/O region and the controller-sensitivity link for the N/C region remain unmeasured for the current parent. The discriminating observable for a from-zero suffix experiment: if the N/O region shows formation and retention under the current controller while the N/C region shows no controller sensitivity, the cooperative N/O hypothesis is favored; if the reverse, the scaffold-context hypothesis is favored. One principal intervention per from-zero experiment; no capability gap is claimed because the listed geometry calculators are implemented and tested.
